description: Emails a prepared flight offer to the traveller as a formal offer they can accept. Takes only the confirmation_token from preparing it, and sends a real email.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token returned when this write was prepared. Valid for 15 minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for this request, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments returns the first result instead of sending again. Kept for 24 hours.

name: egf_send_flight_offer
title: Email a flight offer
